# Security

The tool is only published at https://github.com/JRDevo/Monitor-in-VR-Game (Releases page). Copies from any other site
are not mine; do not run them.

If you find a security problem (for example in the layer DLL or the installer's registration step), please open an issue
and mark it **[Security]** in the title. If it should not be public, say so in the issue without details and I will reply
with a private channel.
